question: Taking South Australia's 7:30-8:00 am half-hour (Adelaide time, ACST) on 20 August 2026: what POE10, POE50 and POE90 operational demand values were in the final forecast run issued ahead of it, and what operational demand was actually measured?

shown_answer.headline: South Australia measured operational demand of 1567 MW for the half-hour ending 2026-08-20 08:00 ACST.
summary: For 2026-08-20 07:30–08:00 ACST, the requested final run issued before the half-hour started forecast POE10 operational demand of 1663 MW, POE50 of 1594 MW and POE90 of 1525 MW.
The updated actual measurement was within the same run's published forecast range.
Selection followed the requested run's issue time, not its public-availability time.
Across the available matching targets in the requested broader review window, this run's mean absolute error was 149.81 MW.

numeric_claims.text: Mean absolute error across available matching targets was 149.81 MW.

uncertainties: The actual demand value uses the latest available updated revision.
The broader-window mean absolute error covers only targets paired with the requested run; it is not the error for the requested half-hour alone.
missing_evidence: The requested run had no matching forecasts for broader-review targets ending 2026-08-19 21:00 UTC, 2026-08-19 21:30 UTC and 2026-08-19 22:00 UTC; these were excluded from the broader-window comparison. No requested-half-hour values are missing.
